## Description / 概要
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
(不具合の内容を簡潔に記載してください)

## Steps to Reproduce / 再現手順
1. Turn on radio tuned to `104.8 MHz`
2. Open Trading UI and place an order
3. See error

## Expected Behavior / 本来の挙動
What you expected to happen.
(期待される正しい動作)

## Logs / エラーログ (`console.txt`)
If you encountered a red error, please attach relevant lines from:
`C:\Users\<YourUser>\Zomboid\console.txt`

```text
(Paste error stack trace here / ここにスタックトレースを貼り付けてください)
```

## Environment / 環境
- **Project Zomboid Version**: Build 42 (e.g. 42.0.x / 42.1.x)
- **Mod Version**: (e.g. v1.0.0.39)
- **Mode**: Single Player / Multiplayer (Dedicated or Hosted)
- **Other Mods**: List any potentially conflicting mods
